settings.heading: The Diamond and Gemstone Wedding Ring Guide

settings.content: Setting styles, coverage, stone layout and shaped-to-fit bands

settings.heading: Where to Begin
settings.body:
A stone-set wedding band has more decisions in it than an engagement ring: how the stones are held, how far they travel around the finger, how they are laid out, and how the whole thing sits against the ring already on the hand.

Most of those decisions are permanent. Coverage in particular determines whether the ring can ever be resized, which is why it is worth settling before anything else.

This guide takes them in a sensible order and is direct about the trade-offs.
